about.description: XIDR is an Indonesian rupiah stablecoin from StraitsX, intended for IDR-denominated transfers and payments with onchain settlement. It follows a centralized issuance model with offchain IDR reserves and supports permissionless transfers on public chains, enabling IDR liquidity for fintech integrations and web3 use cases in Southeast Asia.
about.registryInfo: StraitsX - issuer/brand for regional fiat-backed stablecoins used in Southeast Asia. XIDR is positioned as an IDR-backed stablecoin within the StraitsX ecosystem; licensing and reserve reporting are provided via StraitsX's disclosures.
